limitations: 108 assistant-localized balls in correlated short windows, not independent human ground truth. Approximate boxes include blur; some balls are airborne. New Jersey validation remains separate from California/Georgia training. Conditional visibility evaluation cannot establish full-game precision, recall, possession or shots. Threshold selection uses 16 validation frames and is highly uncertain. These are development results, not a held-out full-video test. IoU is sensitive to approximate tiny-ball boxes.
